name: useSpeech
summary: Speaking text aloud with the voices the phone has installed.
plain: Reads text out loud. This is the output half of voice: useSpeechAI listens, this one talks back. Which voices exist depends on what the user has downloaded in system settings, so check the list rather than assuming a language is available.
description: Wraps expo-speech for the system voice and can address an installed Android TTS service by package name without changing the phone default. Explicit-engine calls fail closed unless Android exposes an exact active-package match: PixelKit inventories and rechecks the installed package/version, resolves voice/locale identity, and rejects missing, changed, mismatched or unobservable engines before synthesis. Platform TTS, explicit Android TTS and Gemini Live audio use distinct output identities. External apps own installation and model downloads; their internal execution provider is not inferred. Speech runs require explicit trace context.

returns.name: isPaused
returns.desc: Whether speech is paused rather than stopped.

returns.name: voices
returns.desc: Installed voices, each with an identifier, name, language and quality.

returns.name: speechEngines
returns.desc: Android TTS services installed on the device, including package label/version and external installation ownership; empty when unavailable.

returns.name: lastSpeechIdentity
returns.desc: Observed identity for the latest output. Platform TTS, explicit Android TTS and Gemini Live audio are distinct discriminated types.

returns.name: lastSynthesis
returns.desc: Latest explicit-engine terminal result with utterance identity, callback timestamps, status and redacted trace correlation.

returns.name: voice
returns.desc: Selected voice identifier, or null for the system default.

returns.name: maxInputLength
returns.desc: Longest string the engine accepts in one call.

returns.name: lastSpokenText
returns.desc: Text of the most recent utterance.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

actions.name: speak(text, run, options?)
actions.type: (text: string, run: SpeechRunOptions, options?: SpeakOptions) => Promise<void>
actions.desc: Speaks through platform TTS or one exact explicit Android engine under caller-owned trace context. Await it to sequence utterances.

inputs.name: text
inputs.desc: What to say. Trimmed first; blank resolves immediately. Longer than maxInputLength is rejected, not truncated.

inputs.name: run
inputs.desc: Explicit immutable trace context and optional local observability sink/redaction policy.

inputs.name: options.language / options.voice
inputs.desc: Requested BCP-47 locale or voice identifier. Explicit-engine identity reports the voice and locale Android actually selected.

inputs.name: options.rate / options.pitch / options.volume
inputs.desc: Per-utterance speech controls; rate and pitch default to the hook values and volume ranges from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: options.enginePackage
inputs.desc: Installed Android TTS service package for this utterance. Missing, changed, mismatched or unobservable active identity is rejected before synthesis.

inputs.name: options.onIdentityResolved / onStart / onDone / onError
inputs.desc: Correlated local callbacks. Identity resolves before explicit text submission; terminal and late callbacks are accepted at most once for the owning utterance.

actions.output: Resolves on completion or stop. Rejects invalid text, unavailable identity, initialization/configuration failure, or synthesis error. Callback evidence does not prove audible voice identity.

actions.name: stop()
actions.desc: Stops speaking immediately and discards the queue.
actions.output: Resolves once stopped; isSpeaking and isPaused become false. Any pending speak promise resolves rather than rejecting.

actions.name: pause() / resume()
actions.desc: Suspends and continues an utterance. Not supported by every engine.
actions.output: Resolves once applied; where the engine does not support it, error explains that and isPaused is unchanged.

actions.name: checkSpeaking()
actions.desc: Asks the engine directly rather than trusting the local flag.
actions.output: Resolves with the engine answer, which is also written to isSpeaking. False when the engine cannot be reached.

actions.name: refreshVoices()
actions.desc: Re-reads installed voices, which changes when the user downloads one in system settings.
actions.output: Resolves with the list, also written to voices. Empty array on failure, with the reason in error.

actions.name: refreshSpeechEngines()
actions.desc: Re-reads Android TTS services and package versions after installation, update or removal.
actions.output: Resolves with the installed services, also written to speechEngines. Empty on unsupported platforms or failure, with the reason in error.

actions.name: voicesForLanguage(languageTag)
actions.desc: Filters the installed voices to one language, so you can offer a real choice.

inputs.name: languageTag
inputs.desc: A prefix such as 'en' or a full tag such as 'en-GB'. Matched case-insensitively.

actions.output: Returns the matching voices; empty when none are installed for that language.

actions.name: resolveSpeechEngineIdentity(packageName, run, options?)
actions.type: (packageName: string, run: SpeechRunOptions, options?: { language?: string; voice?: string }) => Promise<AndroidTtsIdentity>
actions.desc: Initializes and inspects one explicit Android TTS package without speaking.
actions.output: Returns installed/resolved package and version, exact-match evidence, initialization state, selected voice/locale and explicit unavailable/error reason.

actions.name: verifySpeechEngine(phrase, run, options)
actions.type: (phrase: string, run: SpeechRunOptions, options: SpeechVerificationOptions) => Promise<SpeechVerificationResult>
actions.desc: Resolves exact engine identity before submitting a caller-supplied verification phrase.
actions.output: Returns the pre-submission AndroidTtsIdentity plus a correlated terminal SpeechSynthesisResult. Audible identity still requires independent user/device evidence.

actions.name: getSpeechEngineStatus()
actions.desc: Reads the native engine's current or last terminal state without inferring provider identity.
actions.output: Returns correlated status/identity/timestamps when the native bridge is present, otherwise null.

actions.name: setVoice(id) / setRate(n) / setPitch(n)
actions.desc: Defaults applied to later calls to speak, unless that call overrides them.

inputs.name: value
inputs.desc: A voice identifier from voices, or null for the system default; for rate and pitch, 1 is normal.

actions.output: Returns nothing; voice, rate and pitch update.

agentNote: Pass explicit trace context and await speak. For an explicit Android package, preflight with resolveSpeechEngineIdentity or use verifySpeechEngine; never infer the external app's execution provider or audible voice from binding/callback success.
